messages.subject: GCC Executive Leadership | Energy, Sustainability, Corporate Affairs and Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear Frater Consulting Team,

Your Dubai executive-search practice across energy and commodities, together with your focus on senior talent strategy and market intelligence, makes this a relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and country-facing coordination within a major gold-mining operation.

My current work includes senior engagement with ministries and regulators, renewable-energy transition, carbon-accounting governance, social performance, institutional partnerships and complex cross-functional matters with executive-level visibility. Across 12+ years, my experience spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC. My strongest sector alignment is mining, energy, natural resources, infrastructure and industrial operations.

I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming senior mandates where sustainability, stakeholder leadership and country-facing execution are central to the brief. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
